// A control for tests/intent/design-conventions (test_intent_step_texts_are_never_clamped):
// a mutant that turns the test red, a step text wrapped in <Clamp>. Not a source file (.txt).
export function Mutant({ t }: { t: (k: string) => string }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <Clamp className="steps__intro">{t("steps.intro")}</Clamp>
      <Clamp className="steps__explain">
        <strong className="steps__name">{t("steps.name.errors")}</strong>
        {t("steps.explain.errors")}
      </Clamp>
    </div>
  );
}
